Subject: RE: POC trial environment: hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC - next steps

Hi Amit / Priya 

Thanks again for the demo earlier  great conversation and lots of alignment on success criteria. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same plan going into the POC: 

Success criteria (what Acme AI will evaluate):
- Latency: average inference p99 under 300ms for chat workloads (seq len ~512)
- Cost: token cost target <$0.002/token at target throughput
- Reliability: sustained 99.9% availability during business hours for 2 weeks of testing
- Quality: no significant regression vs your current model baseline on the provided eval set (eval pass rate > 95%)

Evaluation plan / timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): confirm environment choice, exchange network requirements and tech contacts
- Week 1: environment provisioned and initial load tests (sanity + smoke)
- Week 2: run production-like workload tests and run eval set, iterate on config (batching/quantization)
- Week 3: finalize results and recommendation

Environment options (pros/cons):
1) Hosted Redwood sandbox (fastest onboarding)
   - Pros: immediate access, no VPC setup, managed creds and logs, 24-48h provision
   - Cons: network egress policy may require allowlist, not suitable if you need full VPC isolation

2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU pool)
   - Pros: predictable throughput & latency, dedicated quota, better isolation, SLA option
   - Cons: ~3-5 business day provisioning for dedicated slots depending on capacity

3) VPC-connected trial (hosted control plane + customer VPC)
   - Pros: meets strict network/security requirements, private connectivity, KMS/HSM options
   - Cons: requires network team involvement to setup peering/privatelink/firewall rules; typically 5-10 business days

Ask: Can you confirm which environment you prefer to start with for the 3-week POC? If you want, we can start with Hosted sandbox immediately and migrate to VPC or Dedicated for the full evaluation window.

Technical owners from our side: Dev Patel (technical lead) and Laura Bennett (solutions engineer). Dev, Laura  Ive CCd you for the network/infra details.

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (checklist + required inputs), network-requirements.csv (IP ranges, ports).

If this plan looks good, Amit/Priya, can we lock in the environment choice by EOD Friday and schedule a 30m kickoff next week?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

VPC-connected trial:

- Steps: setup AWS PrivateLink / Azure Private Endpoint (or GCP VPC peering), exchange routing table CIDRs, setup KMS key access if needed.
